description: Canonical node ontology for the Astro Design System architecture graph.

types.description: A person or autonomous agent that initiates or performs work.
Supplied evidence, context, or parameters consumed by a workflow.
A user instruction interpreted by the agentic routing layer.
A routing mechanism that selects rules, modes, or downstream processes.
A condition that selects, permits, pauses, or blocks a path.
An executable activity that reads, transforms, validates, or coordinates state.
The primary authority for one explicitly named concern.
A durable file or generated projection used by people or automation.
A reusable UI component or an architectural grouping of components.
A reusable value, token, layout, typography, motion, or elevation foundation.
A deterministic check that can accept or reject architecture or implementation state.
A non-automated checkpoint requiring an explicit human decision.
A tool or system outside the repository that participates in a workflow.
A terminal, reader-facing, runtime, or published workflow result.
A named current or target condition used to separate observations from proposals.
